name: sol_defi_general_8
description: Same-block deposit-then-withdraw enabling flashloan deposit-harvest-withdraw exploits
question: The source file in `source` implements deposit and withdraw (or redeem/claim/harvest) functions that grant benefits based on deposit amount, but contains no mechanism (such as a timestamp/block-number check, lock period, or cooldown) preventing a user from depositing and withdrawing or harvesting benefits within the same transaction or block, allowing a flashloan-funded deposit-harvest-withdraw cycle to extract rewards without real capital exposure, excluding protocols that explicitly enforce a minimum holding period, use time-weighted balances, or otherwise block same-block withdrawal.
criteria: deposit() credits shares/balance and withdraw() lets the same address remove funds with no minimum elapsed time or block delay check between the two calls
harvest() or claimRewards() computes rewards from current balance immediately after deposit() with no snapshot delay or vesting so a same-tx deposit+harvest+withdraw yields rewards
a staking or yield function updates rewardDebt/shares on deposit and allows withdraw() in the same block without checking lastDepositBlock or a cooldown timestamp
a bonus/discount is calculated from deposit size and immediately claimable via withdraw() in the same transaction with no lock-up enforced
